name: icons
title: Icons
description: Gives 76 mobile icons as Flutter paths, from Gravity UI, Lucide, Tabler or Phosphor as the preset says: arrows, chevrons, search, cart, heart, play. Directional ones flip right to left.
changelog: Eighteen more icons in all four sets, for finance and crypto screens: arrow-up, arrow-down, arrow-up-right, arrow-down-left, arrow-up-arrow-down, chart-column, chart-line, chart-column-stacked, chart-donut, table, qr-code, wallet, credit-card, shield, airplane, briefcase, ticket and coins. The two diagonal arrows, for send and receive, flip right to left. Where a set has no glyph it lends its nearest: Lucide a pie for the donut, Tabler a split board and Phosphor a kanban board for the stacked columns, Gravity UI a dollar coin for the coins. The other 58 do not change.

fr: ajouter un jeu d'icônes à l'application
afficher une flèche de retour ou un chevron qui suit le sens de lecture
montrer un cœur, une étoile ou un panier
signaler un statut par un symbole d'information ou d'alerte
afficher lecture et pause dans un lecteur audio
poser des symboles en tracés, sans police ni Material
en: add a complete set of common mobile icons to the whole app
show a back arrow or a chevron that follows reading direction
use a heart, star or cart icon for favorites and the cart
show an info, success or warning glyph
use glyphs drawn as paths, without a font or Material

notFor: a tappable close cross: use a close button (close-button)
a menu that slides from the edge, opened by the three-line icon: use a drawer (drawer)

fr.title: Icônes
